capabilities: Filter notes progressively with include and exclude tag filters
Suggest relevant tags with per-tag note counts
Fuzzy-search note names, paths, aliases, and frontmatter titles
Insert links to found notes directly from the editor
Open or reveal found notes via keyboard or context menus
extras: The README is bilingual (EN, RU) and notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's search and quick switcher don't guide you through tag-based filtering or suggest which tags will narrow results in a large vault.
summary: Tag-based note finder that progressively narrows results with include/exclude tag filters, then refines by name, path, alias, or title.
